title: Moonweave Governance Document Metadata
description: Frontmatter required on authoritative governance documents.

decision_scope.description: Stable lowercase kebab-case identity for the decision governed by an RFC or ADR.

related.description: Reciprocal links to related records. Local documents use relative paths.

supersedes.description: Older governed records replaced by this record.

superseded_by.description: Newer governed records that replace this record.

consolidation.description: Set new-authority only when a new hot canonical record cannot supersede an existing record in the same domain and type.
